doubts: The page describes several separate tracks from the main wharf at Post Office Bay, not one walk, so kind is network; each track has its own time heading and is recorded as its own way. W1 is marked main only because one way must be. Post Office Bay has no name or feature entry, so the starts have no ref. The tracks are recorded as out_and_back because the times are 'return to Post Office Bay', but the page says connected paths allow returning by a different route. The route out to each track is not described, so via is empty. Flagstaff Point can be descended and returned via Sydney Cove, which has no heading or time of its own, so it is not a separate way. The West End Beach / Boulder Beach loop ('an easy round trip of about three hours') is not recorded as a way because its start and direction are not stated. Halfmoon Bay and Golden Bay are the boat departure points; the text does not say which track they join, so onto is null.
